info.title: Citizen API
info.description: Self-service APIs for the citizen-facing Insurance portal: registration, login, profile, dependents, documents, the enrollment wizard, application tracking, and the digital insurance card. Endpoints are grouped below in the order a real citizen workflow follows - start with **Authentication**.

post.summary: Registers a new patient account and immediately logs them in.
post.description:
Call this once, from the citizen-facing registration screen, before any other Domain 1 endpoint.
Anyone (unauthenticated) may call it. Creates a patient with role "Patient" - NationalId must be
exactly 14 digits and unique; Username must be unique. The password is hashed with BCrypt before
being stored - it is never saved or returned in plain text. On success, a JWT is returned
immediately so the caller is logged in right after registering; store it and send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent call.

example.address: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

201.description: Account created. Returns a JWT and the new user's basic info.

400.description:
Validation failed - a required field is missing, or NationalId/MobileNumber/
            Password doesn't match its required format.

409.description: NationalId or Username is already registered to another account.

post.summary: Logs in with NationalId and password.
post.description:
Call this from the login screen every time a returning user signs in. Works for any role -
Patient, Doctor, or Admin - since all three are checked by NationalId. Anyone (unauthenticated)
may call it. Returns the same generic error for an unknown NationalId or a wrong password, so
callers cannot use this endpoint to enumerate which national IDs are registered.

200.description: Credentials valid. Returns a JWT and the user's basic info.

post.summary: Issues a JWT for an existing account without checking a password. Development environment only.
post.description:
Not for frontend use - QA/tooling only, to skip typing a password while exploring the API in
Swagger. Returns 404 outside the Development environment, so it can never be reached in
production. Pass any seeded or registered NationalId and get back a valid token instantly.

200.description: Account found. Returns a JWT and the user's basic info.

404.description: No account with this NationalId, or the API is not running in Development.

get.summary: Returns the identity of the currently authenticated user, as read from their JWT.
get.description:
Useful for a frontend to confirm a stored token is still valid and see who it belongs to (e.g.
on app startup, before showing a logged-in UI). Requires a valid Bearer token from
/register, /login, or /test-token - any authenticated role may call it.

200.description: Returns the caller's identity as read from the JWT claims.

get.description:
Call this to populate a profile screen, or before showing the enrollment wizard's Step 2 (a
complete profile is required before an application can be submitted). Patient only - always
returns the caller's own record, there is no patientId parameter.

example.address: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

404.description: No CitizenProfile found for this patient (should not happen - one is created automatically at registration).

put.summary: Replaces the authenticated patient's editable profile fields.
put.description:
Call this from the profile-edit screen, or from Step 2 of the enrollment wizard. Covers only
CitizenProfile-owned fields (Occupation, MaritalStatus, Nationality, PreferredLanguage,
EmergencyContactName, EmergencyContactPhone) - Patient identity fields are not part of this
request. This is a full replace: send every field you want kept, since an omitted/null field
clears it. Patient only - always updates the caller's own record.

example.address: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

400.description: A field fails validation (e.g. EmergencyContactPhone isn't a valid phone number, or a field exceeds its max length).

404.description: No CitizenProfile found for this patient (should not happen).

post.summary: Registers a dependent (family member) for the caller's own account.
post.description:
Call this from Step 3 of the enrollment wizard, or any time a citizen wants to add a family
member to their account. Restricted to Patient, always for the caller's own account - the
sponsor is derived from the caller's own claim, never a request parameter. Creates both the
dependent's identity and the sponsor relationship together, in one transaction.

200.description: Registered. Returns the new dependent and relationship.

400.description: A required field is missing, or NationalId (if provided) isn't exactly 14 digits.

get.summary: Gets a patient's registered dependents and each relationship's status.
get.description:
Call this to list a citizen's family members, e.g. on Step 3 of the enrollment wizard. Restricted
to the Patient themselves (own patientId only) - Doctors have no access to this endpoint at all,
and Admin no longer does either: use GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review
instead, which shows exactly which dependents were captured in a given application's submission
snapshot.

200.description: Returns the dependent list (empty if none).

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

patch.summary: Ends a family relationship (e.g. divorce, revoked guardianship).
patch.description:
Call this when a citizen removes a dependent from their account. Restricted to Patient, and only
the sponsor who owns this relationship. Sets EndedAt - never deletes the relationship or the
underlying dependent record, so the history remains visible.

404.description: No such relationship, or the caller is not its sponsor.

get.summary: Gets the patient's own currently active card.
get.description:
Call this to show a citizen their own current, usable card (e.g. a "My Card" screen with
            a QR code) - this is the only card-read endpoint a Patient token can call; GetCards/GetDetail
            above are Admin-only. Access is Admin (any patientId) or the Patient themselves (own patientId
            only). Returns only a card that is Status == Active and not yet past ExpiresAt, scoped to the
            patient's own card (not a dependent's).

404.description: No such patient, the caller has no access, or no currently active card exists.

post.description:
Call this from Step 4 of the enrollment wizard, once per required document. Restricted to
Patient, always for the caller's own account - PatientId is derived from the caller's own claim,
never a form field. Only PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG files up to 10 MB are accepted. Uploading a
document of a DocumentType that already has one does not overwrite it - the previous document
remains permanently visible in history, and the new upload becomes "current" (the one that
counts toward enrollment readiness).

file.description: Required. The file itself (PDF/JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 10 MB).

documentNumber.description: Optional. The number printed on the physical document (e.g. a National ID number).

expiresAt.description: Optional. The document's own printed expiry date, if it has one.

dependentPersonId.description: Optional. Set this to upload a document about a specific dependent instead of the citizen themselves - must be one of the caller's own, currently-active dependents.

200.description: Uploaded. Returns the new document's metadata and secure URL.

400.description: Missing file, disallowed file type, over the 10 MB limit, or an invalid dependentPersonId.

502.description: Cloudinary (file storage) is unreachable or rejected the upload.

get.summary: Gets a patient's full document history (their own documents and any about their dependents), newest first.
get.description:
Call this to show upload history, or which documents are already on file. Restricted to the
Patient themselves (own patientId only) - Doctors have no access to this endpoint at all, and
Admin no longer does either: use GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review instead,
which shows exactly what was captured in a given application's submission snapshot.

200.description: Returns the document history (empty list if none).

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

get.summary: Gets a single document's metadata and secure download URL.
get.description:
Call this to view or download one specific document. Ownership is checked against the
document's own PatientId before the URL is ever returned - restricted to the Patient themselves,
same as the history endpoint. Admin: use
GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review instead.

404.description: No such document, or the caller has no access to it.

post.summary: Creates a new Draft application for the caller.
post.description:
Prefer POST /api/insurance/enrollment/start instead, which does this same step as part of the
guided wizard. Call this directly only if building outside the wizard. Restricted to Patient,
always for the caller's own account. Rejects with 409 if the patient already has a non-terminal
application.

200.description: Created. Returns the new Draft application.

409.description: The patient already has a non-terminal application.

patch.summary: Submits a Draft application for review, gated on enrollment readiness.
patch.description:
Prefer PATCH /api/insurance/enrollment/submit instead, which returns a structured
"missingRequirements" array on failure - this endpoint returns the same information as a plain
text message in the 400 body. Restricted to Patient, and only the application's own owner.
Validates readiness (required documents, profile completeness, dependents validity, category
eligibility rules where a category was selected) before completing - the same rules the wizard's
gated endpoint enforces, since both call the same readiness check internally. Snapshots every
currently-current CitizenDocument and every active dependent into the application's permanent
record - this snapshot is never re-taken later, even if the application is later sent back to
WaitingForDocuments and forward again.

400.description: Not ready for submission - the response Detail text lists what's missing/invalid.

404.description: No such application, or the caller does not own it.

409.description: The application is not currently in Draft.

patch.description:
Call this when a citizen abandons an in-progress application (e.g. to start over with a
different category). Restricted to Patient, and only the application's own owner. Any
non-terminal status can be cancelled.

404.description: No such application, or the caller does not own it.

409.description: The application is already in a terminal status (Approved/Rejected/Cancelled).

get.summary: Gets a patient's applications, newest first.
get.description:
Call this to show a citizen's application history. Access is Admin (any patientId) or
            the Patient themselves (own patientId only) - no Doctor access.

200.description: Returns the application list (empty if none).

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

get.summary: Gets full application detail, including its review history.
get.description:
Call this for an application detail/case screen. Same access rule as the list endpoint.
            InternalNotes on each review entry is populated only when the caller is Admin.

404.description: No such application, or the caller has no access to it.

get.summary: Gets full application detail by its human-readable reference number.
get.description:
Same access rule and detail shape as the Guid-based detail endpoint - for citizens/staff
            who only have the printed/spoken reference number (e.g. "APP-2026-00000015"), such as a support
            call or a printed confirmation.

404.description: No such application, or the caller has no access to it.

get.summary: Gets the active insurance categories, in display order.
get.description:
Call this to populate Step 1 of the enrollment wizard (category selection) - it shows the
citizen each category's required documents and eligibility rules up front. Any authenticated
caller may call it.

200.description: Returns the active category list (empty if none are configured yet).

example.name: Government Employee
example.description: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

documentRequirements.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

get.summary: Gets a single insurance category's detail.
get.description:
Any authenticated caller may call it - e.g. to show full detail after the citizen taps a
            category in the wizard.

example.name: Government Employee
example.description: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

documentRequirements.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

404.description: No such category.

get.summary: Gets a patient's current insurance eligibility.
get.description:
Call this to display a citizen's eligibility state, e.g. on a case-review or status screen.
Restricted to Doctor and Patient: a Doctor only a patient they have an existing visit with or are
explicitly assigned to; a Patient only their own record. Admin no longer has direct access here -
use GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review, which includes the applicant's
current eligibility alongside everything else needed to review an application. An inaccessible
patient returns the same 404 as a patient that doesn't exist at all. A patient who exists but has
never been checked also returns 404 - that's a normal, expected state, not an error.

example.reason: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Patient.

404.description: No such patient, the caller has no access, or no eligibility record exists yet.

post.summary: Starts a new enrollment: Step 1 of the wizard, right after the citizen picks a category.
post.description:
Call this once the citizen has chosen a category from GET /api/insurance/categories. Creates a
Draft InsuranceApplication and links it to a new InsuranceEnrollment row. Patient only. Rejects
with 409 if the patient already has a non-terminal application/enrollment - call GET /current
first to check for one before showing the "start" screen.

400.description: The category exists but is not currently active.

404.description: No insurance category with this id.

409.description: The patient already has a non-terminal application - finish or cancel it first.

get.summary: Gets the caller's current (non-terminal) enrollment, if any.
get.description:
Call this when the wizard screen loads, before deciding whether to show "Apply for Health
Insurance" (404 = no active enrollment, start fresh) or resume an in-progress one (200 = resume
at whichever step makes sense given the returned ApplicationStatus). Patient only.

404.description: No active enrollment - the citizen hasn't started one, or their last one is Approved/Rejected/Cancelled.

get.summary:
Gets the readiness checklist for the caller's current enrollment: Step 4 of the wizard, to show
upload progress.
get.description:
Call this after each document upload to refresh the checklist UI (e.g. checkmarks next to
required documents). A 200 response with "isReady": false is the normal, expected state while
the citizen is still uploading - it is not an error. Patient only.

200.description: Returns the readiness result (isReady may be false - this is not an error).

404.description: No active enrollment.

get.summary: Gets everything the Review step needs for the caller's current enrollment: Step 5 of the wizard.
get.description:
Call this once, right before showing the final Review screen, instead of calling
Profile/Dependents/Documents/Readiness separately - it aggregates all of them in one response.
Patient only.

404.description: No active enrollment.

patch.summary: Submits the caller's current enrollment for review, gated on readiness. The final action of the wizard.
patch.description:
Call this from the Review screen's "Submit" button. Checks readiness first; if not ready, returns
400 with a structured "missingRequirements" array describing exactly what's missing/invalid, e.g.
`{"missingRequirements":["National ID is required.","Minimum age for Student is 18 (you are 16)."]}`
- render these directly to the citizen. Only when ready does it actually submit. Patient only.
Prefer this endpoint over calling PATCH /api/insurance/applications/{id}/submit directly - both
now enforce the same readiness rules, but only this one returns the structured breakdown.

400.description: Not ready for submission - see "missingRequirements" in the response body.

404.description: No active enrollment.

409.description: The application is not currently in Draft (e.g. already submitted).

get.summary: Gets a patient's aggregated insurance status timeline in one call.
get.description:
Call this once to populate a citizen's insurance status dashboard, instead of calling Insurance
Applications, Insurance Eligibility, Insurance Verification, and Documents separately. Access is
Admin (any patientId) or the Patient themselves (own patientId only) - no Doctor access.

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

get.summary: Gets a patient's most recent insurance verification, regardless of whether it's still valid.
get.description:
Restricted to Doctor and Patient: a Doctor only a patient they have an existing visit with or are
explicitly assigned to; a Patient only their own record. Admin no longer has direct access here -
use GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review, which includes the applicant's most
recent verification alongside everything else needed to review an application.

example.reason: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Patient.

404.description: No such patient, the caller has no access, or no verification exists yet.

get.summary: Gets a patient's currently valid insurance verification, if one exists.
get.description:
Call this to gate an action on "is this patient's insurance usable right now" - unlike "latest",
this does not simply return the most recent row, it applies the same validity rule
(Status = Verified and not yet expired) everywhere else in this API. If the most recent
verification is stale, not verified, or pending, this returns 404 even though "latest" would
still return that row.

example.reason: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Patient.

404.description: No such patient, the caller has no access, or no currently valid verification exists.

get.summary: Gets a patient's full insurance verification history, newest first.
get.description: Same access policy as the other read endpoints in this controller.

200.description: Returns the verification history (empty list if none).

example.reason: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Patient.

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access.

nationalId.description:
Optional - a dependent (especially a young child) may not have a National ID yet. If
            provided, must be exactly 14 digits.

AddDependentRequestDto.description:
Request payload for registering a dependent. Creates a DependentPerson and its FamilyRelationship to
the caller together, in one call - a dependent never exists without a sponsor.

reviewHistory.description:
Newest first. InternalNotes on each entry is populated only for an Admin caller - a
            Patient caller sees null there.

ApplicationDetailResponseDto.description: Full application detail, including its review history.

applicationNumber.description:
Human-readable reference, e.g. "APP-2026-00000015" - the primary reference to show
            users. Id (below) remains the internal identifier used by every other endpoint in this
            controller (submit/cancel/review/detail).

reviewedBy.description: AdminId of whoever most recently reviewed this. Null until the first review.

decisionReason.description:
Citizen-visible reason for the final decision - set only once Status becomes Approved or
            Rejected.

documentCount.description: Number of documents captured in this application's snapshot at submission time.

dependentCount.description: Number of dependents captured in this application's snapshot at submission time.

reviewedBy.description: AdminId of whoever performed this review.

citizenVisibleReason.description: Shown to the citizen. Required at the service level when NewStatus is Rejected.

internalNotes.description:
Set only when the caller is Admin - null for a Patient caller, enforced in the
            service.
internalNotes.example: Employment letter confirmed with HR department.

ApplicationReviewResponseDto.description: A single review action taken on an application.

ApplicationStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of an insurance application. Values: Draft, Submitted, UnderReview,
WaitingForDocuments, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled. Valid transitions (see
InsuranceApplicationService.AllowedTransitions): Draft -> Submitted -> UnderReview ->
WaitingForDocuments -> UnderReview -> Approved/Rejected, and Draft/Submitted/UnderReview/
WaitingForDocuments -> Cancelled. Approved, Rejected, and Cancelled are terminal - no outgoing
transitions.

token.description:
The JWT bearer token. Pass it in Swagger's Authorize dialog, or in an
            "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header on every other call.

expiresAtUtc.description:
UTC expiry of the token - the frontend should re-authenticate (log in again) once past
            this time.

userId.description: Internal numeric id of the account (Patient, Doctor, or Admin row).

AuthResponseDto.description: Response returned after a successful register, login, or test-token request.

cardNumber.description:
Human-readable reference, e.g. "INS-2026-00000015" - the primary reference to show
            users. Id (below) remains the internal identifier used by every other endpoint in this
            controller.

patientId.description:
The sponsor/owning account - always set, even when the card belongs to a
            dependent.

dependentPersonId.description:
Null = this card belongs to the Patient themself. Set = belongs to that specific
            dependent.

isCurrentlyValid.description: Computed at read time: Status == Active && DateTime.UtcNow <= ExpiresAt.

version.description:
Layout/schema version of this card row. Always 1 today - reserved for future card-layout
            changes.

cardTemplate.description: Reserved for future card layouts. Always null today.

tokenVersion.description:
Confirms a rotation succeeded without exposing the token itself - VerificationToken
            remains permanently excluded from every response.

predecessorCardId.description: The card this one superseded via Renew/Replace - null for a card issued via Issue.

successorCardId.description: The card that superseded this one, if any - resolved at read time, not stored.

isLatestCard.description:
True when SuccessorCardId is null - avoids requiring every client to check for null
            themselves.

expiresAt.description:
IssuedAt plus the configured DefaultValidityMonths (12 months by default), computed once
            at issuance and never recomputed.

applicationId.description: The Approved application that authorized this issuance.

CardResponseDto.description:
A digital insurance card's current state. VerificationToken is deliberately never
            included here - it is the opaque secret embedded in the card's QR/NFC payload.

CardStatus.description:
Closed set of Digital Insurance Card states. Values: Active, Suspended, Revoked, Superseded.
Deliberately no "Expired" value - expiry is derived at read/verify time from ExpiresAt, never a
stored status flip. Superseded is system-set only, when a replacement/renewal card is issued - never
a client-requested transition.

displayName.description:
Resolved label: the Admin-configured DisplayName, or a static fallback derived from
            DocumentType when none was set.

helpText.description:
Short inline guidance shown next to the upload field in the enrollment wizard. Null if
            not configured.
helpText.example: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

sampleDocumentUrl.description: Optional link to an example/template document. Null if not configured.

displayOrder.description: Sort order among the category's requirements, ascending.

isActive.description: False = soft-disabled - excluded from RequiredDocumentTypes and readiness checks.

isMandatory.description: False = Optional - shown to the citizen but never blocks readiness/submission.

CategoryDocumentRequirementDto.description:
Full detail of a single required document row on an insurance category - the Admin
            management view (unlike InsuranceCategoryResponseDto.RequiredDocumentTypes, which is the plain,
            citizen-facing, active+mandatory-only list).

dependentPersonId.description:
Set when this document is about a specific dependent rather than the uploading citizen
            themselves (e.g. a dependent's own birth certificate). Null = the citizen's own document.

documentNumber.description: The number printed on the physical document. Optional, no format validation.

fileUrl.description: Secure (HTTPS) Cloudinary URL - the download link.

fileType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file - one of application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png.

fileSize.description: Size in bytes. Max 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes) at upload time.

expiresAt.description: Optional, citizen-supplied - e.g. a National ID's printed expiry date.

isCurrent.description:
True if this is the most recent upload of its DocumentType for its
            (PatientId, DependentPersonId) - computed by the service, never the client. An earlier upload of
            the same type is still visible in history (false) but no longer counts toward enrollment
            readiness.

dependentPersonId.description: The dependent's own identity id - distinct from RelationshipId below.

nationalId.description: Null if the dependent doesn't have one registered yet.

relationshipId.description:
Id of the sponsor-to-dependent relationship row - use this (not DependentPersonId) with
            the End Relationship endpoint.

isPrimarySponsor.description: True if this sponsor was the first to register this dependent.

endedAt.description:
Null while the relationship is active. Set once ended - the relationship row is never
            deleted, only ended.

isActive.description: Computed: true when EndedAt is null.

DependentResponseDto.description: A dependent, joined with the sponsor's relationship to them.

DependentStatus.description:
A dependent's own life/record status. Values: Active, Inactive, Deceased. No business rules
            are enforced around this yet - the field exists for future workflows to build on; new dependents
            always start as Active.

DocumentReviewStatus.description:
A document's review outcome. Values: Pending, Approved, Rejected. Exists to prepare CitizenDocument's
schema for a future document-review capability - no endpoint today sets anything other than the
default (Pending), so a frontend should not expect to see Approved/Rejected yet.

DocumentType.description:
Closed set of insurance-application document types. Values: NationalId, BirthCertificate,
MarriageCertificate, EmploymentLetter, DisabilityCertificate, DeathCertificate,
GuardianAuthorization, FamilyRegistration. Deliberately no generic "Other" value - a new
document type gets its own enum value later, matching the approach already taken for VerificationContext.

EligibilityStatus.description:
A citizen's national health insurance eligibility outcome. Values: Eligible, NotEligible,
            PendingReview, Suspended, Expired.

isReady.description:
True only when every check below passes. This is the single flag that gates
            Submit.

missingRequirements.description:
Human-readable, combines missing documents and eligibility violations - render this list
            directly to the citizen (e.g. as a bullet list of what's still needed).

missingDocumentTypes.description:
Machine-readable subset of MissingRequirements - the specific DocumentTypes still not
            uploaded.

isEligibleForCategory.description:
False if the citizen's age or marital status doesn't meet the category's eligibility
            rule, or the category disallows dependents and the citizen has one.

eligibilityViolations.description:
The eligibility-specific subset of MissingRequirements (e.g. age/marital-status
            violations).

profileComplete.description:
False if required CitizenProfile fields (occupation, marital status, nationality,
            emergency contact) are missing.

dependentsValid.description:
False only if a structural data-integrity problem exists among the citizen's active
            dependents - effectively always true in normal use.

documentsComplete.description: False if any of the category's required document types hasn't been uploaded yet.

applicationExists.description: False if there is no active enrollment/application to check at all.

EnrollmentReadinessResponseDto.description:
Structured result of an enrollment readiness check - never thrown as an exception, always a
populated result (see EnrollmentReadinessService). MissingRequirements combines missing documents
and eligibility violations into one human-readable list; MissingDocumentTypes/EligibilityViolations
break that same information out for a frontend that wants to render the two kinds of issue separately.

applicationId.description:
The Draft InsuranceApplication created alongside this enrollment - use this Id with the
            Insurance Applications endpoints if you ever need to bypass the wizard.

correlationId.description: Cross-domain tracing id, useful when correlating with audit logs.

EnrollmentResponseDto.description: An insurance enrollment - the category chosen for the citizen's current application attempt.

dependents.description: The citizen's registered dependents - same shape as GET /api/insurance/dependents/{patientId}.

documents.description: The citizen's uploaded documents - same shape as GET /api/insurance/documents/{patientId}.

missingDocumentTypes.description:
Document types still required but not yet uploaded - same list as
            EnrollmentReadinessResponseDto.MissingDocumentTypes.

EnrollmentSummaryResponseDto.description:
Everything the frontend needs for the enrollment wizard's Review step, in one call. Purely an
aggregation of existing modules (Profile/Dependents/Documents, reused as-is) plus the enrollment's own
category and readiness - duplicates no data.

code.description:
Stable machine key, unique across all categories - not shown directly to
            citizens.

name.description: Display name shown to citizens in the wizard.

description.example: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

isActive.description:
False = the category is soft-disabled and no longer selectable for new enrollments (it
            still appears on any enrollment that already used it).

displayOrder.description: Sort order for displaying categories in a list, ascending.

requiredDocumentTypes.description:
Every DocumentType the citizen must upload to be ready to submit under this category -
            active and mandatory requirements only.

documentRequirements.description:
Full detail for every requirement, including inactive/optional ones - the Admin
            management and Preview view. RequiredDocumentTypes above is the filtered subset of this list.

allowedMaritalStatuses.description:
Empty = no marital-status restriction. Non-empty means the citizen's profile
            MaritalStatus must be one of these values.

guardianRequired.description:
Informational only - not automatically enforced (there's no automated way to verify a
            guardian relationship). Shown as a manual-review note during Admin review instead.

dependentsAllowed.description: False means an applicant with any active dependent cannot use this category.

InsuranceCategoryResponseDto.description: An insurance enrollment category and the criteria configured for it.

reason.example: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.

checkedBy.description: AdminId of whoever recorded this decision.

updatedAt.description: Null if this is the first decision ever recorded for this patient.

InsuranceEligibilityResponseDto.description: A patient's current national health insurance eligibility state.

currentApplicationNumber.description:
Human-readable reference of the patient's most recent application. Null if they've
            never applied.

timeline.description:
Ordered stages of the application's progress, for rendering a visual progress
            tracker.

documentCount.description: Total number of documents the patient has on file.

InsuranceStatusResponseDto.description:
Citizen-facing insurance status timeline - a read-only aggregation over the patient's most recent
InsuranceApplication, InsuranceEligibility, InsuranceVerification, and CitizenDocuments. Never
includes ApplicationReview.InternalNotes - see InsuranceStatusService.

reason.example: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

expiresAt.description:
Set only when Status is Verified - computed from
            Insurance:Verification:DefaultValidityHours (24 hours by default) at the moment of
            verification.

verifiedBy.description: DoctorId or AdminId of whoever performed this verification.

isCurrentlyValid.description:
Computed by the service, never the client: true when Status is Verified and ExpiresAt
            (if set) has not yet passed.

IssueReason.description:
Why a specific card row was issued. Values: Initial (first card for the primary applicant),
Renewal (via POST .../renew), Replacement (via POST .../replace), Dependent (first card for a
dependent), Migration (reserved for future bulk data-migration scenarios).

nationalId.description:
Egyptian National ID of the account to log in as. Required, exactly 14
            digits.

password.description: Account password, in plain text over HTTPS. Required.

LoginRequestDto.description: Request payload for logging in. Works for any role (Patient, Doctor, Admin).

MaritalStatus.description:
Marital status, part of a Patient's CitizenProfile. Values: Single, Married, Divorced,
            Widowed. Also used by Insurance Categories to restrict which marital statuses may enroll under a
            given category (e.g. the "Widow" category requires Widowed).

role.description: "Patient", "Doctor", or "Admin", read directly from the JWT's role claim.

MeResponseDto.description: Response for GET /api/auth/me, reflecting the claims present in the caller's JWT.

patientId.description: Read-only. Internal numeric id of the Patient account.

nationalId.description: Read-only. Set at registration, never editable here.

username.description: Read-only. Set at registration, never editable here.

fullName.description: Read-only. Computed from the four Patient name parts.

email.description: Read-only. May be null - registration does not require an email.

address.example: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

createdAt.description:
Read-only. When the underlying CitizenProfile row was first created (automatically, at
            registration).

updatedAt.description: Read-only. Null until the first PUT /api/profile call.

ProfileResponseDto.description:
Response for GET/PUT /api/profile: read-only Patient identity plus the editable CitizenProfile
fields. Patient identity fields (NationalId, Username, DateOfBirth, Gender, MobileNumber,
Governorate, District, Email, Address) are managed exclusively by Patient/Registration and are
never editable through this endpoint.

nationalId.description:
Egyptian National ID. Required, exactly 14 digits, must be unique across all
            accounts.

firstName.description: First given name. Required, max 50 characters.

secondName.description: Second name (typically the father's name). Required, max 50 characters.

thirdName.description: Third name (typically the grandfather's name). Required, max 50 characters.

fourthName.description: Fourth name (typically the family name). Required, max 50 characters.

mobileNumber.description: Egyptian mobile number. Required, must be a valid phone number.

email.description: Optional. When provided, must be a valid email address.

address.description: Full street address. Required, max 300 characters.
address.example: 12 El Nasr Street, Nasr City, Cairo

username.description: Login username. Required, max 50 characters, must be unique across all accounts.

password.description:
Plain-text password, hashed with BCrypt before being persisted - never stored or returned in
plain text. Required: at least 8 characters, including letters, numbers, and at least one
special character.

RegisterRequestDto.description: Request payload for patient self-registration. The resulting account is always created with role "Patient".

RelationshipType.description:
Closed set of family relationship types between a sponsoring Patient and a DependentPerson.
            Values: Spouse, Child, Parent, Guardian.

ReplacementReason.description:
Closed, structured reason captured on a card issued via Replace. Values: Lost, Damaged, Stolen,
Other. "Other" plus the optional free-text ReasonNote covers anything not worth its own enum value.

ReviewOutcome.description:
The business decision behind a review action. Values: Approved, Rejected, NeedMoreDocuments.
Distinct from ApplicationReview.NewStatus (the workflow-engine state) - this field is null on a
review row that just moves the application into UnderReview (e.g. picked up for review, or moved
back from WaitingForDocuments) since there's no concluded outcome yet. Computed by
InsuranceApplicationService from the requested NewStatus, never client-supplied directly.

insuranceCategoryId.description:
Required. The Id of an active InsuranceCategory (from GET /api/insurance/categories) to
            enroll under.

SubmissionChannel.description:
Where an application was submitted from. Values: WebPortal, MobileApp, AdminPortal, Kiosk,
GovernmentImport. Only WebPortal is produced today - the only intake path this API exposes; the
other values are reserved for future channels without needing another migration.

nationalId.description:
NationalId of any seeded or registered account (Patient, Doctor, or Admin). Unlike Register/Login,
this does not require exactly 14 digits - this endpoint is Development-only, so a short id is
fine for quick manual testing.

TestTokenRequestDto.description: Request payload for the development-only test-token endpoint. No password required.

stageName.description: Display name of this stage, e.g. "Submitted", "UnderReview", "Decision".

isComplete.description: True if the patient's application has reached or passed this stage.

timestamp.description: When this stage was reached. Null if not yet reached.

TimelineStageDto.description: One stage in a patient's insurance status timeline.

occupation.description: Optional. Max 100 characters. Omit/null to clear.

nationality.description: Optional. Max 100 characters. Omit/null to clear.

preferredLanguage.description: Optional. Max 50 characters. Omit/null to clear.

emergencyContactName.description: Optional. Max 200 characters. Omit/null to clear.

emergencyContactPhone.description:
Optional. Must be a valid phone number if provided, max 20 characters. Omit/null to
            clear.

UpdateProfileRequestDto.description: Request payload for PUT /api/profile. Covers only CitizenProfile-owned fields - Patient identity fields (NationalId, Username, DateOfBirth, Gender, MobileNumber, Address, etc.) are not part of this DTO and cannot be changed through this endpoint. This is a full replace of the CitizenProfile fields: send every field you want to keep on every call - an omitted/null field clears whatever was there before, it does not leave it unchanged.

UserRole.description: Role assigned to an authenticated user, included as a claim in the issued JWT.

VerificationContext.description:
Which operational workflow prompted an insurance verification. Values: Appointment, CheckIn,
ClinicVisit, EmergencyAdmission, Billing. A closed, curated set on purpose - if a new business
context appears, add a new value rather than falling back to a generic "Other".

VerificationSource.description:
Where a verification decision came from. Values: Manual, GovernmentApi, Imported, System. Only
Manual is produced today - no external integration exists yet. Kept independent from
EligibilitySource (not reused) since the two features may evolve this concept differently over time.

VerificationStatus.description:
The outcome of a single insurance verification event, decided at the moment it was checked.
            Values: Verified, NotVerified, Pending.

Bearer.description: Enter a JWT token. Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." (the "Bearer " prefix is added automatically).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Register (once) → Login → receive a JWT → send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other Domain 1 call.

tags.name: Citizen Profile
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** GET the profile to display it → let the citizen edit the editable fields → PUT to save. A complete profile is a precondition for submitting an insurance application - see Insurance Enrollment Wizard.

tags.name: Insurance Categories
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** GET the active category list (Step 1 of the enrollment wizard) → show each category's required documents and eligibility rules → citizen picks one to start enrollment with.

tags.name: Insurance Enrollment Wizard
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Start enrollment (pick a category) → Complete Profile → Manage Dependents → Upload Required Documents → poll Readiness → Review Summary → Submit. This group is the recommended path for a citizen applying for insurance - it wraps and validates the lower-level Applications/Documents/Dependents endpoints below.

tags.name: Dependents
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Add a family member (spouse/child/parent/guardian) → list them → end a relationship if it no longer applies. Used from Step 3 of the enrollment wizard.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Upload a document by type → list uploaded documents to show progress → upload again to replace an outdated one. Used from Step 4 of the enrollment wizard.

tags.name: Insurance Applications
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Create a Draft → submit it for review → track its status → cancel it if no longer needed. The enrollment wizard drives these automatically; call them directly only outside the wizard flow.

tags.name: Insurance Eligibility
tags.description: **Admin-only.** Records a citizen's national health-insurance eligibility outcome, used as a read-only snapshot when an application is finally decided.

tags.name: Insurance Verification
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** A doctor or admin verifies a citizen's coverage at the point of care (appointment, check-in, billing) and records the outcome.

tags.name: Insurance Status Tracking
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** One call a citizen-facing dashboard can use to show application status, eligibility, verification, and document count together, instead of calling four endpoints.

tags.name: Digital Insurance Card
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Once an application is Approved, Admin issues a card → citizen/provider can fetch or verify it by its QR/NFC token.
